data.title: ABM and LaGuardia Gateway Partners Launch Autonomous Robotics Pilot at Terminal B, Setting a New Standard for Airport Guest Experience
data.description: Robotic deployment includes autonomous floor scrubbers, autonomous vacuums, and one of the first autonomous robotic dogs in a U.S. airport terminal NEW YORK, July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ABM (NYSE: ABM), a leading provider of facility, engineering and infrastructure solutions, announced today the launch of a robotics program at LaGuardia Airport’s award-winning Terminal B.
